OpenComposite (OpenVR -> OpenXR), the two DLLs next to this file in bin\: vrclient.dll (32-bit) and vrclient_x64.dll (64-bit).

Project:   OpenComposite, https://gitlab.com/znixian/OpenOVR  (branch openxr)

           (it also contains Valve's OpenVR headers, MIT/BSD: docs\licenses\OpenComposite-OpenVR-headers-LICENSE.txt,
            inih, BSD: docs\licenses\OpenComposite-inih-LICENSE.txt, and the OpenXR SDK, Apache-2.0)

           (1.0.1539, "Set Quest ModelNumber_string prop to Oculus Quest", 2025-05-30; the revision the DLLs print at start)

AirFrameXR does not link to these DLLs and does not change them. It copies nothing into a game: the launcher's OpenVR line only points the system-wide
OpenVR runtime path (%LOCALAPPDATA%\openvr\openvrpaths.vrpath) at this folder, or back at SteamVR. OpenVR games then load these DLLs, which translate
OpenVR into OpenXR for the active OpenXR runtime (AirFrameXR). Deleting this folder removes OpenComposite.
